purpose: On issue events, post or update a warning comment listing labels that are not in labels.yml, with guidance on canonical prefixes.

jobs.summary: Checkout (fetch-depth 0), setup Node, npm ci, load labels.yml with js-yaml, skip bot authors, comment (marker-deduplicated) when non-canonical labels are present.

failure_points.issue: The guidance comment recommends five labels that are not in labels.yml (type:documentation, area:docs, area:labels, meta:duplicate, meta:blocked).
The link './.github/labels.yml' in an issue comment resolves relative to the issue URL and is broken.
labeled/unlabeled triggers produce one run per label change (the #3531 event-storm pattern).
When labels become canonical the job returns early and leaves the earlier warning comment in place.
Full-history checkout and npm ci only to read labels.yml.
Duplicates the detect-bare-labels job in labeling-governance.yml.
